title: Senior Account Executive, Mid-Market
description:
Peoplegrid is the HR and payroll platform for growing companies in the Middle East, trusted by 2,500 businesses from Riyadh to Cairo.

The role
As a Senior Account Executive on our Mid-Market team you'll win new customers with 100 to 1,000 employees across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. You'll own the full sales cycle from first meeting to signed contract, with SDR and solutions consulting support.

What you'll do
- Build and close a pipeline of new business with mid-market companies
- Run discovery and demos with HR, finance and C-level buyers
- Forecast accurately in Salesforce
- Work with Customer Success on a smooth handover

What you'll bring
- 4+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally HR, payroll or finance software
- A record of beating quota in the GCC market
- Experience with MEDDIC or a similar qualification framework
- Arabic and English

Compensation: base AED 28,000 - 32,000 per month plus uncapped commission (OTE about double base). Visa, health insurance and annual flight provided.

Hybrid, three days a week in our DIFC office.

Peoplegrid is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Account Executive, SMB
description:
Peoplegrid is the HR and payroll platform for growing companies in the Middle East.

Our SMB team helps companies with 10 to 100 employees move off spreadsheets. As an Account Executive you'll run a high-velocity sales cycle: many short deals, usually closed in two to three weeks.

What you'll do
- Run 6-8 demos a day with small business owners
- Close new business against a monthly quota
- Keep Salesforce up to date

What you'll bring
- 1-2 years of sales experience, SDR to AE promotion welcome
- Energy, resilience and great phone skills
- Arabic is a plus

Compensation: base AED 15,000 - 18,000 per month plus commission. Hybrid in DIFC.

Peoplegrid is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Gulfstone supplies concrete admixtures and waterproofing systems to contractors across the GCC.

We're looking for a Business Development Manager to grow our share with main contractors and developers in Dubai and the Northern Emirates.

Key responsibilities
- Identify and win new projects with contractors, consultants and developers
- Get our products specified at the design stage with consultants
- Prepare quotations and negotiate supply contracts
- Meet monthly sales targets and report pipeline in our CRM
- Attend site visits and technical meetings

Requirements
- 5+ years of B2B sales in construction chemicals or building materials
- Strong network with contractors in the UAE
- Engineering degree preferred
- UAE driving licence

Salary AED 20,000 - 25,000 per month plus car allowance and quarterly incentive. Office and site based.

title: Account Manager, Motor Insurance
description:
Falcon Shield is a leading insurance broker in the UAE, serving 80,000 customers.

As Account Manager for Motor Insurance you'll look after our fleet and individual motor customers, handle renewals and grow revenue through new business and cross-selling.

Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of motor insurance accounts and renewals
- Generate new business through referrals, walk-ins and dealer partnerships
- Achieve monthly premium targets
- Coordinate with underwriters and claims

Requirements
- 2+ years in insurance sales
- Knowledge of UAE motor insurance regulations
- Valid UAE driving licence

Salary AED 12,000 - 15,000 per month plus commission. Office-based in Deira, six days a week.

title: Partnerships Manager, GCC
description:
Payloop lets businesses in the Gulf accept payments online and in store, with one integration and next-day settlement.

The role
We're hiring a Partnerships Manager to build our channel across the GCC: e-commerce platforms, ERP vendors and SaaS companies that can embed Payloop and refer merchants to us.

You will
- Identify, sign and launch new partners across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar
- Negotiate commercial terms and revenue share
- Build joint go-to-market plans and co-sell with partners' sales teams
- Own partner-sourced revenue targets

You have
- 5+ years in partnerships, alliances or B2B sales, ideally in SaaS or payments
- A strong network across the GCC tech ecosystem
- Experience negotiating commercial agreements
- Arabic and English

Base AED 30,000 - 35,000 per month plus bonus. Hybrid in Dubai Internet City.

Payloop is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, KSA
description:
Coraline Cloud is a customer service platform used by 9,000 companies worldwide. We're expanding fast in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The role
You'll be one of our first Enterprise Account Executives based in Riyadh, selling to the largest companies and government entities in the Kingdom.

What you'll do
- Win new business with enterprise and public sector accounts
- Run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 6-12 months
- Work with partners and system integrators
- Exceed an annual new ARR quota

What you bring
- 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales, with deals above USD 250k
- A network in KSA enterprise and government
- Experience with MEDDICC
- Arabic and English

This role requires you to be based in Riyadh full time and work from our office. Relocation support is available.

Coraline Cloud is an equal opportunity employer.
